decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component of the firm's established exchanger offer, so keeping them on the market costs little, and the lack of archived pages since 2019 leaves their value unresolved rather than disproven, which still justifies holding the option.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's technology base and cost little to carry across its exchanger lines; the 2019 removal of other launches suggests portfolio pruning, but there is no clear evidence that this option has failed.
